user.title: Waarneming
user.description: Rare sightings from waarneming.nl / observation.org around your Home zone and in areas you follow.

data_description.use_home: Sightings within the radius of zone.home (read at each update; the location is never stored).
data_description.add_areas: Area ids or links like https://waarneming.nl/locations/701925/, one per line. Sub-areas are included.
data_description.min_rarity: Rarity as waarneming.nl rates it for that place.
data_description.species_group: 1 = birds (other groups use waarneming.nl's group ids).
data_description.max_sightings: The newest ones go into the `sightings` attribute; the state counts all.
